snippet.title: Matchbox CATERPILLAR Big Dirt Movers - Quarry Zone
snippet.description: Gold has been discovered near this quarry. It needs to be transferred in order for the gold pieces to be melted into golden bars which are then delivered to a bank (smart idea to use a bulldozer to transfer money instead of a freakin' armored truck). Use the excavator to lead the gold onto the dump truck. The dump truck then delivers the gold into the mine to be turned into those bars.
